selection_instruction: Use a current official product photograph that shows a recognizable robot vacuum and dock in a warm, practical residential scene. Keep natural materials and restrained dark-green accents. Reject text, headline posters, charts, decorative network lines, translucent panels, inset frames, floating UI cards, progress bars, generic diagrams, and invented hardware.
crop_instruction: Center-crop to 16:10 while keeping the full robot and dock visible, then verify the centered 16:9 library-card crop.
